description: List the event's speaker portal tasks (bio, photo, slides, travel, agreements, and custom tasks). Use it to see what speakers still owe before send_speaker_reminder or create_speaker_task. Returns tasks[] with id, title, type, status, dueDate, and the assigned contactId, plus total, truncated, and assignmentsIncomplete.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_speaker_tasks

assignmentsIncomplete.description: True when some task assignments could not all be read.

type.description: Task type, e.g. bio_update or slide_upload.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
